title: What to Wear in Berlin in Winter - Quick Summary
items: **The usual winter afternoon is about 4°C**, December to February, 12:00 to 15:00. The wind takes **about 3 degrees** off, so it feels close to 1°C.
**Wet beats frozen:** rain or snow of 1 mm or more fell on close to **3 days in 10** over ten winters. Days that stayed below freezing were about **6 in 100**.
**The coat:** windproof, water-resistant, with a hood, covering your hips. A wool coat alone soaks through.
**The shoes:** waterproof boots with real tread. Berlin normally bans salt on pavements, so ice can stay for days.
**Museums:** the State Museums do not allow heavy coats or wet clothing in the galleries, so wear layers you can take off.
**My move:** tap your hour on the grid in this post, then pack for the hard-day number, not the usual one.
